description: Guard hooks recognize git commit after git-global options
prompt: Fix hooks/guard.py. Its commit detector currently recognizes only `git commit ...`, so `git -c key=value commit`, `git -C path commit`, and long global-option forms bypass the guard. Parse git-global options conservatively, classify commit invocations, and do not classify unrelated commands.

fake.good_response: Updated the guard to skip value-taking and flag-only git-global options before identifying the subcommand.
fake.bad_response: Added a special case for git -c.
